title: UiReplayEvent
description: One line of a .replay.jsonl file: a single recorded user UI interaction. The file is JSON Lines (one event per line); each line must validate against this schema.

type.description: Interaction kind. Currently only clicks are recorded.

node.description: The UI node id that was interacted with (the 'what').

uiFrame.description: The UI frame (relative to the first event in the session; first event = 0). Records the 'when'.

pointer.description: The cursor (pointer) position at the moment the interaction fired (viewport coordinates). Records the 'where'.
